Title: Kindred Society Games vs Sensory Deprivation [LSJ]

Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:
If you have a vamp with both KSG and Sens Dep on it, can the vamp untap
during it's Methuselah's untap phase using the KSG (since that is not
"untapping as normal"[Sens Dep text])? Or is the "burns 1 blood to
untap" still referring to the normal untapping of the vamp, it just
burns a blood off them now?

relevant card texts:

*******
Kindred Society Games
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Toreador
Master. Put this card on a ready vampire. [This vampire doesn't untap as
normal]. During the untap phase, that vampire either puts Society Games
on a younger tapped vampire or burns 1 blood to untap. [If the vampire
choses to move the Society Games but] there is no tapped younger
vampire, Society Games is burned.
Kindred Society Games - Master (Tor)
· The last sentence is vague. Replace it with "If the vampire doesn't
untap but instead moves the Society Games on, but there is no tapped
younger vampire to move it to, Society Games is burned instead." [RTR
19941109]
· If a vampire has two copies of Kindred Society Games played on it,
each copy exerts its own effect on the vampire. Thus, untapping the
vampire normally would require the vampire to burn a total of 2 blood.
If the vampire does not untap normally, then both Games are moved to
other vampire(s), although the vampire could burn 1 blood to prevent one
of the Games from moving on. [RTR 19951017]

Sensory Deprivation
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 3 blood
Discipline: Chimerstry
Choose an ally or retainer in play. If an ally is chosen, he or she
does not untap <as normal> during the untap phase as long as the acting
vampire remains in play. If a retainer is chosen, that retainer is
burned. (S) <Choose a vampire in play>; he or she does not untap <as
normal> during the untap phase as long as the acting vampire remains in
play.
*******

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris Shorb wrote:
>
> If you have a vamp with both KSG and Sens Dep on it, can the vamp untap
> during it's Methuselah's untap phase using the KSG (since that is not
> "untapping as normal"[Sens Dep text])? Or is the "burns 1 blood to
> untap" still referring to the normal untapping of the vamp, it just
> burns a blood off them now?

Untapping as normal is not an option, given the card text you cite:

> Master. Put this card on a ready vampire. [This vampire doesn't untap as
> normal]. During the untap phase, that vampire either puts Society Games
> on a younger tapped vampire or burns 1 blood to untap.

A vampire with KSG can pay a blood to untap, even when prohibited from
untapping "as normal" (which he always is, by the text above).
